item_fields.name: cost

item_fields.name: elements

item_fields.name: cost

item_fields.name: cost

item_fields.name: cost

item_fields.name: cost

item_fields.name: elements

item_fields.name: cost
item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric coordination expense the coordinator incurs if this team is selected; the objective is to minimize the sum of coordination_cost for all chosen teams while covering every task exactly once.

global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of ad slots on the campaign grid that must each be filled exactly once by the selected bundles.

item_fields.name: cost

item_fields.name: cost

item_fields.name: elements

item_fields.name: cost

item_fields.name: elements

item_fields.name: cost

item_fields.name: cost

item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a candidate vendor module (e.g., vendor name or module code); used to refer to that module when selecting integrations.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: List of feature identifiers that this module can handle. When modules are selected they must partition the full feature list so each feature appears in exactly one chosen module and no chosen modules overlap on features.

item_fields.name: cost
item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric licensing cost to integrate this module. The goal is to choose modules that cover all features exactly once while minimizing the sum of these license costs.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct course segments that must be assigned to squads so each segment is covered exactly once.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of candidate relay squads available to hire (each is a possible set covering some segments).

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a candidate relay squad (used to refer to that squad when selecting hires).

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: List of course segment identifiers that this squad would cover if hired (these segments must not be covered by any other hired squad).

item_fields.name: cost
item_fields.scenario_description: Monetary stipend charged by the squad if hired; the objective is to minimize the sum of stipends for the chosen squads.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of travel days that must each be assigned an outfit. Each day must be covered by exactly one selected kit.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct outfit kits you can choose from when packing. Each kit is a candidate for covering one or more travel days.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier (label) for an outfit kit. Use this to refer to the kit when selecting which kits to pack.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: The list of travel day indices that this kit supplies outfits for (e.g., [1,2,3]). If you pack this kit, those specific days become assigned to it.

item_fields.name: cost
item_fields.scenario_description: The additional luggage weight (numeric) incurred if this kit is packed. The solver should minimize the sum of kit_weight for all selected kits.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct treatment categories that must be covered exactly once by the selected medical packs (the size of the universe of treatments to partition).

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of different pre-packed medical boxes available to choose from (the number of candidate sets you can select to form the partition).

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a specific pre-packed medical box (used to refer to this candidate pack in decisions and reporting).

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: List of treatment-category identifiers that this medical pack includes; selecting the pack assigns responsibility for each of these treatment categories (they must not overlap with other chosen packs).

item_fields.name: cost
item_fields.scenario_description: The numeric shipping fee for sending this medical pack; the solver minimizes the sum of shipping_cost for all selected packs while ensuring each treatment is covered exactly once.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct customer segments the campaign must reach. In the partitioning view, each of these segments must be assigned to exactly one selected advertising bundle.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: The total count of available advertising bundles offered as choices. Each bundle is a candidate that may be selected to cover some of the customer segments.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for an individual advertising bundle (e.g., 'B1'). Use this id to refer to that bundle when selecting the campaign combination.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: The list of customer segment identifiers that this bundle reaches. If this bundle is chosen, all listed segments are considered covered by it; to satisfy the partition requirement, no two chosen bundles may include the same segment and every segment must appear in exactly one chosen bundle.

item_fields.name: cost
item_fields.scenario_description: The monetary cost to include this advertising bundle in the campaign. The goal is to select bundles whose sum of these prices is as small as possible while forming a valid partition of all customer segments.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of departments that must each receive supplies from exactly one ordered kit. This is the count of distinct department identifiers the office manager must cover.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of vendor kits (candidate supply boxes) offered. Each kit is an option the office manager may order to supply one or more departments.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a vendor kit (a candidate supply box). The office manager uses this ID to reference a specific kit option when selecting which kits to order.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: List of department identifiers that this kit fully supplies. If this kit is ordered, each department in this list would receive its entire supply from this single kit.

item_fields.name: cost
item_fields.scenario_description: Monetary cost to order this kit. The office manager sums the kit_price of all selected kits and seeks the combination that covers every department exactly once at minimum total cost.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct films that must appear exactly once across the selected screening blocks (the size of the festival lineup to partition).

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of candidate screening blocks (each is an offerable time/room block that screens a subset of films) from which the curator may choose.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a candidate screening block (e.g., 'Block A', 'EveningRoom1_Thu') used to reference that block in selections.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: List of film identifiers that this screening block will screen. For a valid partition, selected blocks' film lists must be pairwise disjoint and together cover every film exactly once.

item_fields.name: cost
item_fields.scenario_description: Monetary rental cost to book this screening block (venue/room/time). The objective is to choose blocks covering all films exactly once while minimizing the sum of these costs.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of garden beds that must each receive seeds; every one of these beds must be covered exactly once by the selected seed packs.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of available seed packs to choose from; each pack is a candidate for sowing and may cover one or more beds.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier for a specific seed pack (used to refer to that pack when selecting); must be unique among packs.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: List of garden bed identifiers that this seed pack will sow if chosen; chosen packs must not overlap on any bed and together must assign each bed exactly once.

item_fields.name: cost
item_fields.scenario_description: Monetary cost of selecting (buying/sowing) this seed pack; the solver should minimize the sum of pack_price for the chosen, non-overlapping packs that cover all beds.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct subscriber interest areas that must each receive content from exactly one published bundle. This is the size of the universe to partition.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of candidate article bundles the editor can choose from. Each bundle is a possible selection to cover one or more interest areas.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for this candidate article bundle (used to reference the bundle when choosing which to publish).

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: The list of interest-area identifiers that this bundle provides content for. If this bundle is selected, it claims responsibility for exactly these interest areas in the partition.

item_fields.name: cost
item_fields.scenario_description: The editing/publishing expense incurred if this bundle is selected. The solver should minimize the sum of these costs for the chosen bundles.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct files that must be stored exactly once across the retained backup collections — the size of the universe of files to partition.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of candidate backup collections (archives) available to keep; each is a set that may be chosen to cover some files.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a candidate backup collection (archive). Refer to this when deciding which archives to retain.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: List of file identifiers contained in this archive. If the archive is retained, these files are covered by that single chosen archive; in a valid partition each file must appear in exactly one retained archive.

item_fields.name: cost
item_fields.scenario_description: Monetary cost to retain this archive. The objective is to choose archives whose summed archive_cost is minimized while still covering every file exactly once.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of students that must be placed on exactly one hired bus; this is the size of the student roster to partition among chosen buses.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of candidate buses on the shortlist that may be hired; each corresponds to one available bus option with its own coverage and rental fee.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a specific candidate bus on the shortlist (e.g., bus number or code) used to reference that bus when selecting hires.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: List of student identifiers who would board this particular bus if it is hired; these students must be assigned to exactly one hired bus and no hired buses may have overlapping students.

item_fields.name: cost
item_fields.scenario_description: Monetary fee to hire this bus for the outing; the solver sums the rental_costs of chosen buses and aims to minimize that total while ensuring each student is covered exactly once.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct artworks that must be mounted for the exhibit; every artwork here must be covered exactly once by the chosen panels.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of candidate display panels available for rent that the curator may choose from.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a candidate display panel (e.g., 'P1'); used to reference that specific panel when selecting which panels to rent.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: The list of artwork identifiers that this panel can display. In any valid selection, each artwork identifier must appear on exactly one chosen panel.

item_fields.name: cost
item_fields.scenario_description: The monetary rental fee for using this panel. The solver minimizes the sum of rental_fees of the selected panels while ensuring each artwork is mounted exactly once.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct songs on the station's roster that must each be played exactly once during the show. Use this to verify the chosen playlists cover every roster song.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of available pre-made playlists (candidate mixes) the DJ can choose from to build the show.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a candidate preassembled playlist. Refer to this ID when selecting or reporting which playlists are aired.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: List of song identifiers included in this playlist. Each identifier matches a song on the roster. When playlists are chosen they must be disjoint and together cover every roster song exactly once.

item_fields.name: cost
item_fields.scenario_description: Numeric licensing fee charged if this playlist is aired. The DJ's goal is to minimize the sum of the license fees of the selected playlists while ensuring a partition of the roster.

global_fields.name: num_elements
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct required components that must be provided exactly once across all selected kits. This is the count of unique component types on the procurement list that must each be covered by one chosen kit.

global_fields.name: num_sets
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of candidate supplier kits available to choose from. Each kit is a purchase option that supplies a subset of the required components and has a listed price.

item_fields.name: set_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier (code or name) for a supplier kit option. Use this to refer to which specific kit would be purchased from a vendor.

item_fields.name: elements
item_fields.scenario_description: The list of component identifiers that this kit provides. Each identifier corresponds to a required component; when the kit is selected, it supplies those components and those components must not be supplied by any other selected kit.

item_fields.name: cost
item_fields.scenario_description: The purchase price of this kit (monetary cost). The procurement objective is to select kits whose supplied_components partition the required components while minimizing the sum of these kit_price values.
